description: PAID 0.001 USDC/call, or free trial (3/day/IP). Bytecode security scan of a Base token contract: honeypot opcodes, mint/blacklist/pause/tax capabilities, a risk score and a verdict. Read-only — no transaction is sent. On 402, pay the accepts[] terms then retry with the payment tx hash. (Exposed as `security_scan` on older clients.)

payment.description: Optional X-PAYMENT base tx hash of the USDC payment.

name: token_scan
